title: cyto7: an open, vertex-level cortical type atlas of the human cortex
description:
cyto7 is an open, vertex-level, seven-type cortical type atlas of the human cerebral cortex, hand-painted on the FreeSurfer fsaverage surface following the Garcia-Cabezas protocol and revised by the protocol's authors. This deposition contains the atlas products only: the released v9 annotation files on fsaverage, nearest-neighbour resamples to fs_LR 32k, the per-vertex support map and its components, the crossed parcellation with per-node tables and colour tables, and the full provenance record (as-painted map, superseded versions, per-vertex change logs).

No third-party data is redistributed. The analysis code is on GitHub; see the repository README.
